queries.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN jumlah_kunjungan > 0 THEN jumlah_kunjungan WHEN jumlah > 0 THEN jumlah ELSE 1 END) as sum_cases FROM `data_kunjungan` WHERE `id_dataset` = 24

SELECT `jenis_kelamin`, SUM(CASE WHEN jumlah_kunjungan > 0 THEN jumlah_kunjungan WHEN jumlah > 0 THEN jumlah ELSE 1 END) as total FROM `data_kunjungan` WHERE `id_dataset` = 24 AND `jenis_kelamin` IN ('L','P') GROUP BY `jenis_kelamin` ORDER BY `total` DESC

SELECT `kelompok_usia`, SUM(CASE WHEN jumlah_kunjungan > 0 THEN jumlah_kunjungan WHEN jumlah > 0 THEN jumlah ELSE 1 END) as total FROM `data_kunjungan` WHERE `id_dataset` = 24 AND `kelompok_usia` IS NOT NULL AND `kelompok_usia` != '' AND `kelompok_usia` != 'Umum' GROUP BY `kelompok_usia`

SELECT `kelompok_usia`, SUM(CASE WHEN jumlah_kunjungan > 0 THEN jumlah_kunjungan WHEN jumlah > 0 THEN jumlah ELSE 1 END) as total FROM `data_kunjungan` WHERE `id_dataset` = 24 AND `kelompok_usia` IS NOT NULL AND `kelompok_usia` != '' GROUP BY `kelompok_usia`

SELECT COALESCE(nama_diagnosis, `kode_diagnosis`, "Lainnya") as label, SUM(jumlah_kunjungan) as total FROM `data_kunjungan` WHERE `id_dataset` = 24 AND `nama_diagnosis` IS NOT NULL AND `nama_diagnosis` != '' GROUP BY COALESCE(nama_diagnosis, `kode_diagnosis`, "Lainnya") ORDER BY `total` DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(periode, '%Y-%m') as bulan, SUM(CASE WHEN jumlah_kunjungan > 0 THEN jumlah_kunjungan WHEN jumlah > 0 THEN jumlah ELSE 1 END) as total FROM `data_kunjungan` WHERE `id_dataset` = 24 AND `periode` IS NOT NULL AND `periode` != '0000-00-00' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(periode, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY `bulan` ASC LIMIT 60

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(periode, '%d %b') as bulan, SUM(CASE WHEN jumlah_kunjungan > 0 THEN jumlah_kunjungan WHEN jumlah > 0 THEN jumlah ELSE 1 END) as total FROM `data_kunjungan` WHERE `id_dataset` = 24 AND `periode` IS NOT NULL AND `periode` != '0000-00-00' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(periode, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY `periode` ASC LIMIT 31
